label: Figure 3.1: A demand curve for smartwatches
alt: A downward-sloping demand curve for smartwatches: at $180 quantity demanded is 200 units per week and at $120 it is 400 units.
caption: A demand curve for smartwatches. A fall in price from $180 to $120 raises the quantity demanded from 200 to 400 units per week. This is a movement along the existing curve D, not a shift of it.
